1: // Nebula Runner - simple top‑down endless runner
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Set canvas size to fill the window (you can adjust as needed)
13:   const resize = () => {
14:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
15:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
16:   };
17:   resize();
18:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
19: 
20:   // Ship definition – simple triangle at the bottom centre
21:   const ship = {
22:     width: 30,
23:     height: 40,
24:     x: canvas.width / 2,
25:     y: canvas.height - 60,
26:     speed: 5,
27:     movingLeft: false,
28:     movingRight: false,
29:     draw() {
30:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
31:       ctx.beginPath();
32:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
33:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
34:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
35:       ctx.closePath();
36:       ctx.fill();
37:     }
38:   };
39: 
40:   // Input handling – arrow keys (or A/D)
41:   const keyDown = (e) => {
42:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') ship.movingLeft = true;
43:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') ship.movingRight = true;
44:   };
45:   const keyUp = (e) => {
46:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') ship.movingLeft = false;
47:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') ship.movingRight = false;
48:   };
49:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
50:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
51: 
52:   // Asteroid definition – simple circles falling down
53:   const asteroids = [];
54:   const asteroidSpawnRate = 90; // frames between spawns
55:   let frameCount = 0;
56: 
57:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
58:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
59:     const x = radius + Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius);
60:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
61:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
62:   };
63: 
64:   const updateShip = () => {
65:     if (ship.movingLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
66:     if (ship.movingRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
67:     // Keep ship within bounds
68:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.width / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width / 2, ship.x));
69:   };
70: 
71:   const updateAsteroids = () => {
72:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
73:       const a = asteroids[i];
74:       a.y += a.speed;
75:       if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) {
76:         asteroids.splice(i, 1); // remove off‑screen
77:       }
78:     }
79:     if (frameCount % asteroidSpawnRate === 0) spawnAsteroid();
80:   };
81: 
82:   const checkCollisions = () => {
83:     for (const a of asteroids) {
84:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
85:       const dy = a.y - (ship.y + ship.height / 2);
86:       const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
87:       // Approximate ship as circle of radius ship.width/2
88:       if (distance < a.radius + ship.width / 2) {
89:         return true;
90:       }
91:     }
92:     return false;
93:   };
94: 
95:   let score = 0;
96:   let gameOver = false;
97: 
98:   const drawScore = () => {
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
100:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
101:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 30);
102:   };
103: 
104:   const drawGameOver = () => {
105:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
106:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
108:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
109:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
110:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
111:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
112:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
113:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
114:   };
115: 
116:   const loop = () => {
117:     if (gameOver) {
118:       drawGameOver();
119:       return;
120:     }
121:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
122:     // Update entities
123:     updateShip();
124:     updateAsteroids();
125:     // Draw entities
126:     ship.draw();
127:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
128:     for (const a of asteroids) {
129:       ctx.beginPath();
130:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
131:       ctx.fill();
132:     }
133:     // Score based on time survived
134:     if (frameCount % 60 === 0) score++;
135:     drawScore();
136:     // Collision check
137:     if (checkCollisions()) {
138:       gameOver = true;
139:     }
140:     frameCount++;
141:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142:   };
143: 
144:   // Start the game loop
145:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146: })();
